references.text: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, descendants of Anak, are first mentioned when the spies explored the Hebron area
The spies reported on the descendants of Anak living in the land, the same ones Caleb later drove out
The Anakites are described as giants, and Caleb showed faith by conquering their territory
Joshua wiped out the Anakites from the hill country, including Hebron, which is complemented by Caleb's conquest
Parallel account where Judah struck down Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai in Hebron
Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove out the three sons of Anak, in accordance with Moses' promise
Caleb asks for and receives Hebron as an inheritance, where the Anakites lived, and promises to drive them out
